extracted.name: All purpose fast dough
extracted.description: I need a fast all purpose dough, for bread or pizza This is low hydration dough
instruction_lines: Mix, salt and flour(300g). Yeast, sugar, and water
After the dry ingredients mixed, insert the wet mix, and combine using fork or spoon, let it proofed for 15 minutes
After proofing, knead and shaped the dough into a ball and rest for 15 minutes
At this point the dough can be used, but if you want for it to be more fluffy, youcan proofed it again for 30 minutes
